tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chu yos zla 4tshes 18la glo bo pa zla ba bsam 'grub kyi ngor mdzad gur drag bsnyen yig dge/ swasti/ gur drag bsnyen pa ni/ 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa dang / bkra mi shis pa'i sa phyogs ma yin pa zhig tu rang rang dbang 'dus nges su/ nyer mkho tshang bar byas la/ shar ram lhor phyogs pa'i stan gyi 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram mam g.yung drung gang 'os sa dkar gyis bris pa'i steng rdo shing gang rung gis stan mi rul ba'i thabs byas pa la mi lpags stag lpags gang rung gis gzugs bris pa'i de'i mdun lcogs steng du g.yon nas g.yas su nang mchod dril rdor ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas rnams bshams/ rang gi mdun phyogs su bla bre sogs ci 'byor 'og 'di'i bris 'bur sku drung stegs bu ras sogs bkab par 'bru gcal bkram steng dpal gtor rin chen ma gtor dpe'u bzhin/ g.yas g.yon du thod pa dngos sam thod gzugs sogs kyi nang sman raka mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa sbrengs tshar/ thun bzhir gso ba'i mtheb kyu grib skam lta bus gsos chog 'byor na mchod me zhal zas kyang brjes/ ma 'byor na nyin zhag re bcas/ tshags su tshud par byas la yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu rnam gnyis sam/ yang na zla mjug gza' skar rtsub cing 'phrod sger sgrub khang du cha gsum lan kha yar btang nas bgegs gtor 'dor ba'i tshe drag sngags mang du bzlas shing yungs dkar brab/ sngags gul gyi dud pas bgegs bskrad/ phyi rol rang dbang 'dus par mtshams tho la 'dzugs tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus sogs mang du bshad kyang bsdu na/ sa dkar skya nar gyis kyang chog nang du stan la 'khor nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / bla ma sku gsum ma sogs kyi sku bstod bton la/ skyabs 'gro sogs nas/ thun de'i dngos gzhi skyabs 'gro bla ma bde gshegs nas/ rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs/ bar brgya stong sogs bton rjes/ sems bskyed 'gro la nas shar mar byas la sngags bzlas ci 'grub byas nas thun gyi rjes rnams bya/

de 'dra thun la zhugs nyin/ dgong stod de'i sang gi tho snga'i thun tsam zhig byas nas sems bskyed grangs gsog kyang 'dra/ dngos gzhi/ a tsig ne rtsig sogs 'dogs/ 'phrin gzhung nas bshad pa'i grangs ltar bsags nas thim pa dang / de nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bcas byas nas btson btang ba bzhin mi 'gro bar/ 'gyangs 'dris dang / thag je nyer btang nas mtshams grol ba sogs spyi 'gre yin// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gur drag bsnyen yig glo bo pa zla ba bsam 'grub kyi ngor mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
